extension.description: Diagnose the current workspace for God Classes, technical debt, security issues, and dependency structure.
codeDoctor.setLlmApiKey: Codes Doctor: Set LLM API Key
config.reportOpenMode.description: How to open generated reports: external browser, VS Code WebView, or VS Code URI open.
config.analysisLanguage.description: Language mode used when analyzing the workspace.
config.llmProvider.description: LLM provider used for the optional AI structural review. Set the matching API key via the "Codes Doctor: Set LLM API Key" command.
config.llmModel.description: Model ID to use for LLM review. Leave empty to pick one from the Dashboard's model list (fetched live from the provider).
config.displayLanguage.description: Dashboard, new report, and AI review language. English by default. Run a new analysis after changing this setting; existing reports keep their original language.
config.llmMaxOutputTokens.description: Maximum generated tokens per initial LLM review request (input tokens are separate). Includes reasoning for OpenAI reasoning models. Starting points: 4,000–8,000 for non-reasoning models; 16,000–32,000 for reasoning models. Default: 16,000. Stay within the selected model’s output limit. Empty OpenAI output caused by the limit is retried once with max(2 × this value, 16,000); this can increase cost.
